name: Login uses phone and password
description: Verifies the primary sign-in workflow remains available.
expected: The user reaches the dashboard after successful sign-in.

name: Account data is private and persists
description: Verifies each signed-in account loads only its own fleet records and that its data remains after refresh.
steps: Sign in as Account A and add a vehicle
Sign in as a new Account B
Sign out and sign back in as Account A
expected: Account B starts with no vehicles from Account A; Account A still sees its vehicle after signing back in.

name: Ethiopian calendar works in Amharic
description: Verifies Amharic date fields and the Working Calendar use Ethiopian months, days, navigation, and date conversion.
expected: The selected date is displayed in Ethiopian format and the off-day is saved for the selected vehicle.

name: Monthly Excel export is one row per vehicle
description: Verifies the Excel export summarizes each vehicle once with name, plate, cycle, fill count, total birr, and filled-day count.
steps: Enter multiple fuel records for one vehicle in the same month
expected: The Excel file contains one summary row per vehicle with aggregated fuel count and birr total instead of repeating the same vehicle for every fuel event.

name: Settings persist and affect scheduling
description: Verifies scheduling settings can be changed, saved, and retained.
expected: The selected settings remain enabled or disabled as saved.

name: Sign-in 401 shows an actionable message
description: Verifies failed sign-in explains that the phone and password should be checked rather than exposing a raw HTTP status.
steps: Enter a phone number and password
Submit while the login request returns 401
expected: A readable sign-in message appears and the raw 'Request failed with status code 401' text is not shown.

name: Signup duplicate conflict shows a helpful message
description: Verifies a duplicate-phone conflict is shown as a useful message instead of a raw request status code.

body_json.message: This phone number is already registered. Please check the number and try again.

steps: Submit the signup form while the signup request returns a 409 conflict
expected: A readable duplicate-phone message appears instead of 'Request failed with status code 409'.

name: Fuel cycle counts the start date as working day one
description: Verifies a vehicle whose cycle start date is today begins at working day one, rather than incorrectly showing zero or an unrelated elapsed-day count.
steps: Sign in and add a vehicle with today's date as Last Filled Date
Set Fuel Cycle to 8 working days
Open Vehicle List and review the working-day count and expected fuel date
expected: The vehicle shows 1 working day on the start date, and its expected fuel date is calculated with that date counted as day one, excluding configured off-days.

name: Existing fuel-cycle progress can be entered manually
covers: manual current-cycle progress during vehicle registration
description: Verifies a fleet manager can enter working days already used in a cycle that started before the app was adopted, and that subsequent days continue from that progress.
steps: Enter required vehicle details and set an 8-working-day fuel cycle
Enter 4 in Working Days Already Used (optional)
Save the vehicle and open its details
expected: The vehicle details summary shows 4 entered working days and 4 remaining days for its 8-day cycle; the app continues counting future working days from this manual baseline.

name: Normal fuel fill resets an existing manual cycle baseline
covers: new fuel cycle starts from fill date
description: Verifies recording a normal fuel fill starts a fresh cycle instead of continuing from progress entered for the previous cycle.
steps: Add a vehicle with an 8-working-day cycle and 4 working days already used
Record a normal fuel fill for that vehicle today
expected: The fuel event is recorded, the last-filled date updates to today, and the new cycle progress starts from that fill date rather than the old manual baseline.

name: Fuel Entry carries the selected vehicle from details
description: Verifies opening Fuel Entry from a vehicle's details keeps that vehicle selected without requiring a second selection.
steps: Open Vehicle List and open a specific vehicle's details
Tap Fuel Due or Fuel Entry
Review the Vehicle field before saving
expected: The selected vehicle name and plate are shown as fixed information, with no Vehicle dropdown box; the user can continue without choosing the vehicle again.

name: Fuel priority ranks vehicles by remaining working days
description: Verifies the priority view lists vehicles with the fewest remaining working days first and reflects due status consistently.
steps: Add one vehicle whose last-filled date makes its cycle due
Add a second vehicle with a more recent last-filled date and a longer cycle
Review the order, working-day counts, remaining days, and status labels
expected: The vehicle with zero remaining working days appears before the vehicle with more remaining days, and the displayed status matches the calculated cycle progress.

name: Vehicle-specific off-day is excluded from fuel-cycle progress
covers: expected fuel date shifts for off-days
description: Verifies adding a vehicle-specific off-day does not increase working-day progress and moves the expected fuel date to the next eligible working day.
steps: Sign in and add a vehicle with a 5-working-day cycle and a recent Last Filled Date
Register a weekday as an off-day for that vehicle
Return to Vehicle Details and review working days, remaining days, and expected fuel date
expected: The registered off-day is excluded from the vehicle's working-day count, remaining days do not decrease for that date, and the expected fuel date shifts accordingly; Sundays are also excluded when the default Sunday-off setting is enabled.

name: Editing cycle progress updates remaining days and fuel date
covers: expected fuel date after manual baseline
description: Verifies entering a known working-day or remaining-day count at a chosen past date persists and recalculates today's progress using only eligible working days.
steps: Tap Working Days and inspect the date-by-date details
Tap Remaining Days, choose a date three days ago, and enter the known remaining count for that date
Reopen the Remaining Days details and review today's count and expected fuel date
expected: Both metric boxes open a detailed date-by-date view; saved progress is retained for that vehicle, elapsed working days after the selected date are added, registered off-days and enabled Sundays are excluded, and today's remaining count and expected fuel date update.
